ec_ad.config.book: You can always configure everything you need in mod configuration files.
gui.ec_ad.archie.a_question: I need information about a dino.
gui.ec_ad.archie.deny: Oh, sorry! I didn't mean to get in your way.
gui.ec_ad.archie.friend:
Right behind you. Eyes on the treeline.

Want to talk dinos, or see what I've got for trade?
gui.ec_ad.archie.info:
Ah, a fellow enthusiast!

I've tracked every dino in these lands, so ask away.
Which one do you want to know about?
gui.ec_ad.archie.intro:
Shhh, don't move!

We're in dino territory.
I've been tracking this specimen for weeks.

Take me with you.
I'll fight at your side, and I've got dino knowledge and gear to trade.
gui.ec_ad.archie.on_chorusoatl:
This is a more challenging one to find.
We will have to find a Stronghold and go to The End.
Then, after defeating the Ender Dragon, search for the Chorusoatl in the outer End Islands.
gui.ec_ad.archie.on_coralosaur:
This one lives under water.
Find a Warm Ocean and look for many bubbles rising straight out of sand on the ocean floor.
gui.ec_ad.archie.on_lushsaur:
We should probably head underground.
Find a Lush Cave and keep your eyes peeled. They are very good at blending in.
gui.ec_ad.archie.on_obsidiceratops:
The only environment this one would be comfortable in is very hot.
So we should probably head to the Nether.
gui.ec_ad.archie.on_sculkraptor:
They lurk in the Deep Dark.
Be careful when approaching, because if you encounter a pack they will be aggressive.
gui.ec_ad.archie.on_sculksaur:
If you are sure you want to find it there is only one way.
Go to an Ancient City and bait the Sculksaur by summoning its favorite snack. The Warden.
gui.ec_ad.archie.on_stop: Oh, sorry! I didn't mean to get in your way.
gui.ec_ad.archie.on_therimoss:
Look for a Jungle!
They are quite big so you should be able to see them from afar.
gui.ec_ad.archie.on_trade:
Got something for me?
Let's make a deal!
gui.ec_ad.archie.talk.aboveground_1: Feels strange being out in the open again... stay alert anyway.
gui.ec_ad.archie.talk.aboveground_2: Tracks don't last long up here. We'll have to rely on instinct.
gui.ec_ad.archie.talk.chorusoatl_1: Look up. See them? They always move in a flock.
gui.ec_ad.archie.talk.chorusoatl_2: If one screams, the whole flock will know where we are.
gui.ec_ad.archie.talk.coralosaur_1: See those bubbles? Something massive is sleeping down there...
gui.ec_ad.archie.talk.coralosaur_2: Careful where you dig. If you wake it, there's no putting it back to sleep.
gui.ec_ad.archie.talk.deny: Oh, sorry! I didn't mean to get in your way.
gui.ec_ad.archie.talk.dimensions_1: This place... it doesn't follow the same rules. Stay focused.
gui.ec_ad.archie.talk.dimensions_2: Whatever lives here has adapted. We're the outsiders now.
gui.ec_ad.archie.talk.friend: What do you need? I'm right here.
gui.ec_ad.archie.talk.intro: Shhh, don't move! We're in dino territory. I've been tracking this specimen for weeks. You can join me, if you want.
gui.ec_ad.archie.talk.lushsaur_1: Wait don't move. It's right there... or at least, it was.
gui.ec_ad.archie.talk.lushsaur_2: They blend in when they feel safe. You won't see it unless it wants you to.
gui.ec_ad.archie.talk.obsidiceratops_1: That one feeds on lava. See the glow? That tells you everything.
gui.ec_ad.archie.talk.obsidiceratops_2: If it runs dry, it won't hesitate. Keep your distance.
gui.ec_ad.archie.talk.sculk_raptor_1: Stay sharp. Sculkraptors don't hunt alone.
gui.ec_ad.archie.talk.sculk_raptor_2: If my research is right, the Warden isn't the only thing we should fear...
gui.ec_ad.archie.talk.sculksaur_1: Be careful... down here, even the walls are listening.
gui.ec_ad.archie.talk.sculksaur_2: Don't touch that slime! You'll light yourself up like a beacon to them.
gui.ec_ad.archie.talk.therimoss_1: There... see it? That's a Therimoss. Don't rush it, it barely notices us.
gui.ec_ad.archie.talk.therimoss_2: If you want its attention, you'll need something big. Really big.
gui.ec_ad.archie.talk.underground_1: Can you see anything? We're looking for a Deep Dark... or maybe Lush Caves.
gui.ec_ad.archie.talk.underground_2: Listen closely. Caves like these always hide more than they show.
